title: A Few Words Go a Long Way: Language Guided Robot Policy Synthesis
imageAlt: A Franka Panda arm grasping a green cup, about to place it upright on a small white table
tldr: Tests whether human feedback helps LLM-written robot code beat vision-language-action models: human feedback lifts Code-as-Policies 1.75× over base VLAs, solving tasks VLAs failed completely.
